items.title: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas, part 1
items.en_title: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas, part 1
items.en_oneliner: By wiring SageMaker Canvas into SageMaker Pipelines, GS Caltex moved process engineers' no-code models into production, and the piece shows how ML engineers reuse proven preprocessing flows.

items.title: datasette-cluster-map 0.19
items.en_oneliner: datasette-cluster-map 0.19 is one of the oldest Datasette plugins, now working with Datasette 1.0a42 and depending on the new datasette-leaflet for OpenStreetMap tiles.

items.title: datasette-leaflet 0.3
items.en_oneliner: datasette-leaflet 0.3 fixes the referrer policy so Datasette table pages send the referrer header OpenStreetMap requires for its hosted tile server.

items.title: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
items.en_title: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
items.en_oneliner: When coding agents are billed per task, what counts is the cost of each solved task rather than the price per token — so the post wires LiteLLM to NVIDIA's NeMo Switchyard router through AWS CDK to pick the right model per task.

items.title: Architecture patterns for fast session startup on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
items.en_title: Architecture patterns for fast session startup on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
items.en_oneliner: Bedrock AgentCore runtime V2 snapshots a ready-initialized environment and restores it for every new session, so startup time stops growing with image size; the post walks through the architecture patterns at work.

items.title: OpenFold3 on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: Predict biomolecular structures
items.en_title: OpenFold3 on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: Predict biomolecular structures
items.en_oneliner: OpenFold3-preview can now be deployed from SageMaker JumpStart inside your own AWS account, forecasting the 3D structures of protein, DNA, RNA, and ligand complexes, with async inference and multi-GPU support.

items.title: FAA expands AI advice to manage air traffic congestion across entire US airspace
items.en_title: FAA expands AI advice to manage air traffic congestion across entire US airspace
items.en_oneliner: Airlines welcome the FAA's nationwide rollout of AI advice for easing congestion, though the controllers' union was left out of the process.

items.title: Cost-optimizing AssemblyAI speech-to-text inference on AWS with Amazon EC2 Spot
items.en_title: Cost-optimizing AssemblyAI speech-to-text inference on AWS with Amazon EC2 Spot
items.en_oneliner: AssemblyAI runs speech-to-text inference at scale on ECS, EC2 Spot GPU instances, and an SQS-based retry architecture, cutting costs by 70%.

items.title: Cost attribution and controls for AI developer and productivity tools on Amazon Bedrock
items.en_title: Cost attribution and controls for AI developer and productivity tools on Amazon Bedrock
items.en_oneliner: Built into Bedrock, zero-instrumentation cost attribution traces each inference call back to the IAM principal behind it.

items.title: Build a model improvement flywheel with Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Data Capture
items.en_title: Build a model improvement flywheel with Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Data Capture
items.en_oneliner: HyperPod Data Capture logs live inference inputs and outputs to S3, feeding real traffic back into steady model improvement.
